description.en: Turns culling on or off for a character: when on, the character is not drawn when out of view; the events turn it off for characters that must always be drawn.
true for culling, false to always draw.

true once set, false if the object is not found.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Always drawing a character (real usage, from ev42011700.nut)
